bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 跌破 $164.3，超卖，守在 $158.4 上方

read.en: Nvidia fell 2.0% on Nov 13 to $162.85, trading $158.39–170.00 on heavy volume (1.84x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($170.1), 10-day ($182.8), 30-day ($208.6), 100-day ($212.3) and 200-day ($204.2), all falling. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram flat; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($177.80), and RSI is 24.9, oversold.
read.zh: 英伟达 11月13日下跌 2.0%，收于 $162.85，盘中区间 $158.39–170.00，成交量放大（20 日均量的 1.84 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$170.1）、10 日（$182.8）、30 日（$208.6）、100 日（$212.3）和 200 日均线（$204.2）下方，均在下行。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图持平；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$177.80），RSI 为 24.9，处于超卖。

read.en: The close lost the $164.3–165.9 support (Mar 30 and Nov 10 lows), now resistance; the $170 high stalled at the 5-day. Resistance is $164.3–167.1, then $170–170.8 (5-day, Nov 9 and 11 lows) and $177.5–177.8 (Nov 11 high, SAR). Support is $158.4–160 (Nov 13 low, round number), then $148.8 (52-week low). A close above $167.1 would target $170–170.8; below $158.4, $148.8.

r.en: Mar 30 low $164.27 and Nov 10 low $165.89, broken; Nov 12 high $167.14
Nov 13 high $170; 5-day average $170.1; Nov 9 low $170.24; Nov 11 low $170.77
